title: EACH PLAYER SEES THE OTHER PLAYER LINE OF SIGHT
why: His order of 2026-10-03: each player should see the other player line of sight, with a Settings option to turn it off. What a teammate up top is looking at, you now see too: his view cone is open in your fog of war, a little dimmer than your own, his patch of ground is lit, and an enemy in his sight is drawn for you. Settings has a Shared sight row, On by default.
now: You now see what your teammate sees: their view cone is open in your fog and the enemies in it are shown (Settings: Shared sight).
